name: Man And Woman
overview: Scripture reveals that God created man and woman in His own image as distinct yet complementary beings, established for relationship and unity (Genesis 1:27; 2:18, 24). The union of husband and wife is designed to reflect oneness and mutual dependence, grounded in God's original design. While Galatians 3:28 affirms equality before Christ, Ephesians 5 instructs on the distinct roles within marriage, emphasizing loving leadership by the husband and respectful submission by the wife, all under the lordship of Christ.
